gear.name: Foam earplugs
gear.text: Absorbs one noise complication. The crew all look a bit sleepy.
gear.absorbed: The earplugs go in and the noise does not bother anyone.

gear.name: Cat treats
gear.text: Absorbs one cat complication. Smells of fish.
gear.absorbed: A treat rolls down the corridor and the cat follows it, delighted.

gear.name: Lucky coin
gear.text: Once per heist, one failed or messy action gets another try.

gear.name: Big umbrella
gear.text: Absorbs one wet complication. Slightly embarrassing indoors.
gear.absorbed: The big umbrella goes up and the splash goes sideways.

gear.name: Dust masks
gear.text: Absorbs one dust or pollen complication. Everyone looks like a dentist.
gear.absorbed: The dust masks go on and the cloud drifts by.

gear.name: Flask of tea
gear.text: Absorbs one guard complication. Everybody likes tea.
gear.absorbed: The flask comes out and the guard stops for a cup.

gear.name: Grippy gloves
gear.text: Everyone's Muscle counts one higher, every heist.
